name: Web Traffic Dataset - Single Website
citation: RaminHuseyn. “Web Traffic Time Series Dataset.” Kaggle, uploaded by RaminHuseyn, updated a year ago, https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/raminhuseyn/web-traffic-time-series-dataset.
description: A time series containing observations of the total number of web requests (traffic counts) to a single website. The data is recorded at an hourly (and occasionally half-hourly) frequency, beginning on January 20, 2020.
preprocessing: Load web_traffic.csv; rename Timestamp to timestamps (UTC).
Frequency check: median interval ~3600s suggests hourly, but fill uses a custom grid.
Fill missing (special): drop all rows at exactly 00:00:00 (midnight boundary artifacts); reindex to strict 30min grid (:00 and :30 each hour); missing half-hours become NaN.

Output CSV schema: variable_name, variable_unit, timestamps (JSON array of ISO-8601 UTC strings), values (JSON array; NaN serialized as null via allow_nan=True). Timestamps are shared across variates in multivariate tasks (one row per variate).
